term: actual direct supporter of another individual's existence
definition: PresentEsseSupport m R w₀ c b holds when c exists at the selected actual world and the separate primitive R records c as a direct existential supporter of b there. No c ≠ b condition is built into the raw relation; a well-founded support order rules out actual self-support. R is not identified with generic Ontic.Causes, the transmission of power, temporal production, or an adequate explanatory reason.
note: A source-free typed model for #495. DEF-EXISTENTIAL-SUPPORT-MODEL additionally requires distinct actual individuals and so cannot be reused as an exact synonym. Whether real existential grounding admits this abstraction remains open.
